scope: Real host-generated Parquet over localhost HTTP. Wire bytes counted by server, including discovery and metadata. No wall-time speedup or production Cloudflare heap claim. Revalidated after raw compact metadata admission.
validation: Identical rows under eager and adaptive paths
Cold single-query bytes measured separately with shared cache cleared
Four cold concurrent jobs return identical owned output
Four warm concurrent jobs issue zero data-range requests (discovery excluded)
All output owners released and cache evicted; pool usage returns to zero
limits: Tracked peak spans baseline, adaptive, and concurrent rounds; not actual runtime heap.
Native/emulated mode is observed during discovery; unknown/listed objects without a hint retain the deferred default.
Under allocation pressure emulated transports still use page windows, prioritizing memory bounds over request count.
